components.notes: Poisson laws (including lambda = 0) and the separate sum T_n are defined.
Normalization, mean and variance, and the exact Poisson(n) law of T_n by the multinomial count are proved.
The moving-k local limit, the uniform local approximation, and the interval consequence with exact indices, strict/infinite endpoints and singletons are proved.
components.source_comparison: Durrett Exercise 3.1.2 (p. 115), including the interval conclusion he marks as not part of the exercise.

components.notes: gamma(a) with 0 log 0 = 0, I(a), and log 0 = -infinity are defined.
The interior rate with the rounding k_n = ceil(na), the geometric two-sided comparison, and all extended endpoint rates are proved.
components.source_comparison: Durrett Exercise 3.1.3 (p. 115) and the hint relating consecutive masses to show P(S_n >= k) <= C P(S_n = k).

components.notes: The rate a - 1 - a log a for a > 1 with the exact geometric comparison, and the cases a <= 1 proved separately.
The fixed-p uniform local limit, convergence in distribution, exact interval indices and the p in {0,1} degeneracy are proved; declared as an extension.
